{{Quote|If I don't know anything, they can't beat it out of me later.|Pocka|<ref name="Tempest Feud" />}}
'''Pocka''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who worked for the company [[Skydove Freight]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> as the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Golden Opportunity]]''.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', it was possible for Pocka to transport the player characters to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], so that they could attend a party in [[Popara's penthouse|the penthouse]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]], if the players lacked a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of their own. However, the novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']] established the [[canon]] series of events from the ''Tempest Feud'' storyline and established that the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]]&mdash;who fulfill the role of the ''Tempest Feud'' player characters&mdash;traveled to Nar Shaddaa on the freighter ''[[New Ambition]]'', thus rendering Pocka's transportation of the player characters non-canon.
